verses.sloka: दूषणः तु स्वकम् सैन्यम् हन्यमानम् विलोक्य च ।संदिदेश महाबाहुः भीम वेगान् निशाचरान् ॥३-२६-१॥
verses.transliteration: dūṣaṇaḥ tu svakam sainyam hanyamānam vilokya ca ।saṁdideśa mahābāhuḥ bhīma vegān niśācarān ॥3-26-1॥

translations.english: Mightyarmed Dusana saw the army getting killed in war. He led the forces of five thousand demons, dreadfuly quick at fighting, dangeous to face and who will not beat a retreat.
translations.hindi: अरण्यकाएड का चौवीसर्वा खगे पूरा हुआ | ३ क्र 9 — पञ्चावशः सग; न” 202२ अवष्ठव्यधसुं राम कुड च रिषुधातिनम्‌ । शाश्रपसागग्य सह पुरःसरः

verses.sloka: राक्षसान् पंच साहस्रान् समरेषु अनिवर्तिनः ।ते शूलैः पट्टिशैः कदगैः शिला वरषैः द्रुमैः ॥३-२६-२॥
verses.transliteration: rākṣasān paṁca sāhasrān samareṣu anivartinaḥ ।te śūlaiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ kadagaiḥ śilā varaṣaiḥ drumaiḥ ॥3-26-2॥

translations.english: The demons continuously hurled at him (Rama) spears and swords and rained stones, trees and arrows from all sides
translations.hindi: से कहा कि श्रीरामचन्द्र के सासने रथ ले चलो

verses.sloka: शर वर्षैः विच्छिन्नम् ववर्षुः तम् समन्ततः ।तत् द्रुमाणाम् शिलानाम् च वर्षम् प्राण हरम् महत् ॥३-२६-३॥
verses.transliteration: śara varṣaiḥ vicchinnam vavarṣuḥ tam samantataḥ ।tat drumāṇām śilānām ca varṣam prāṇa haram mahat ॥3-26-3॥

translations.english: Righteous Rama, retaliated with his sharp arrows such as the rain of trees and stones, the mighty destroyers of life.
translations.hindi: खर को आज्ञा के अनुसार सारथी ने घोड़े हाके और वह रथ वहां ले गया, जहाँ पर महावाहु श्रोराम धनुप को टंकोरते ए अकेले खडे थे

verses.sloka: प्रतिजग्राह धर्मात्मा राघवः तीक्ष्ण सायकैः ।प्रतिगृह्य च तद् वर्षम् निमीलित इव ऋषभः ॥३-२६-४॥
verses.transliteration: pratijagrāha dharmātmā rāghavaḥ tīkṣṇa sāyakaiḥ ।pratigṛhya ca tad varṣam nimīlita iva ṛṣabhaḥ ॥3-26-4॥

translations.english: Rama retaliated in great anger to kill without caring for the shower of weapons like a bull with its eyes closed.
translations.hindi: खर को श्रीरामचन्द्र जो के सामने जाते देख, डलके समस्त राक्षस सैनिक ओर सचिव गजेना करते उसके पास जा. और उसे चेर कर, खड़े हो गए

verses.sloka: रामः क्रोधम् परम् लेभे वध अर्थम् सर्व रक्षसाम् ।ततः क्रोध समाविष्टः प्रदीप्त इव तेजसा ॥३-२६-५॥
verses.transliteration: rāmaḥ krodham param lebhe vadha artham sarva rakṣasām ।tataḥ krodha samāviṣṭaḥ pradīpta iva tejasā ॥3-26-5॥

translations.english: Overpowered by anger, Rama, with a blazing glow, covered Dusana and his army with his arrows.
translations.hindi: तब रथ पर चढ़ा हुआ खर, राक्षसों के बीच एसा देख पड़ता था, माना तारा क नांच मद्जल का तारा हा

verses.sloka: शरैः अभ्यकिरत् सैन्यम् सर्वतः सह दूषणम् ।ततः सेना पतिः क्रुद्धो दूषणः शत्रु दूषणः ॥३-२६-६॥
verses.transliteration: śaraiḥ abhyakirat sainyam sarvataḥ saha dūṣaṇam ।tataḥ senā patiḥ kruddho dūṣaṇaḥ śatru dūṣaṇaḥ ॥3-26-6॥

translations.english: Thereafter Dusana, chief of the army, angrily released at Rama equally powerful arrows comparable to thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: र्गो० ) वे सब राक्षस जो बड़े बलवान और मेघ के समान गर्जना कर रहे थे; रथों, घोड़ों और पर्वत समान हाथियों को दौड़ा कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को मार डालने के लिए उन पर बाणों की वर्षा कर, आक्रमण करने लगे

verses.sloka: शरैः अशनि कल्पैः तम् राघवम् समवारयत् ।ततो रामः संक्रुद्धः क्षुरेण अस्य महत् धनुः ॥३-२६-७॥
verses.transliteration: śaraiḥ aśani kalpaiḥ tam rāghavam samavārayat ।tato rāmaḥ saṁkruddhaḥ kṣureṇa asya mahat dhanuḥ ॥3-26-7॥

translations.english: Heroic Rama, mighty angry, then, broke the big bow of Dusana, with his swordlike arrow. And with a series of four arrows cut his four horses to pieces.
translations.hindi: तब तो सब राक्षस क्रद्ध हो, महा-धनुधर एवं दुर्जेय श्रीराम- चन्द्र जी के ऊपर तरह तरह के शम्जां की वपां करने लरे

verses.sloka: चिच्छेद समरे वीरः चतुर्भिः चतुरो हयान् ।हत्वा च अश्वान् शरैः तीक्ष्णैः अर्थ चन्द्रेण सारथे ॥३-२६-८॥
verses.transliteration: ciccheda samare vīraḥ caturbhiḥ caturo hayān ।hatvā ca aśvān śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ artha candreṇa sārathe ॥3-26-8॥

translations.english: After killing the horses with sharp arrows Rama severed the charioteer's head with an arrow of the shape of the crescent moon and pierced Dusana's chest with a set of three arrows.

verses.sloka: शिरो जहार तद् रक्षः त्रिभिर् विव्याध वक्षसि ।स च्छिन्न धन्वा विरथो हत अश्वो हत सारथिः ॥३-२६-९॥
verses.transliteration: śiro jahāra tad rakṣaḥ tribhir vivyādha vakṣasi ।sa cchinna dhanvā viratho hata aśvo hata sārathiḥ ॥3-26-9॥

translations.english: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed, Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it created a horripilation. It appeared as though it could crush the army of gods and render the enemy powerless. It carried the killing touch of the thunderbolt and could break open the enemy's fort.

verses.sloka: जग्राह गिरि शृंग आभम् परिघम् रोम हर्षणम् ।वेष्टितम् कांचनैः पट्टैः देव सैन्य अभिमर्दनम् ॥३-२६-१०॥
verses.transliteration: jagrāha giri śṛṁga ābham parigham roma harṣaṇam ।veṣṭitam kāṁcanaiḥ paṭṭaiḥ deva sainya abhimardanam ॥3-26-10॥

translations.english: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed, Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it created a horripilation. It appeared as though it could crush the army of gods and render the enemy powerless. It carried the killing touch of the thunderbolt and could break open the enemy's fort.

verses.sloka: आयसैः शंकुभिः तीक्ष्णैः कीर्णम् पर वसा उक्षिताम् ।वज्र अशनि सम स्पर्शम् पर गोपुर दारणम् ॥३-२६-११॥
verses.transliteration: āyasaiḥ śaṁkubhiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ kīrṇam para vasā ukṣitām ।vajra aśani sama sparśam para gopura dāraṇam ॥3-26-11॥

translations.english: With his bow and chariot broken, charioteer and horses killed, Dusana took up a spear in his hand that appeared like a huge mountain top. Bound by golden bands, covered the iron nails, wetted with the enemy's marrow it created a horripilation. It appeared as though it could crush the army of gods and render the enemy powerless. It carried the killing touch of the thunderbolt and could break open the enemy's fort.
translations.hindi: जैसे मेघ, पर्वेतां पर जल की वर्षो करते हैं, बैसे ही राक्षसों ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर वाणों की वर्षा की । उस समय उन भयङ्कर राक्षसा ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी को घेर लिआ

verses.sloka: तम् महा उरग संकाशम् प्रगृह्य परिघम् रणे ।दूषणो अभ्यपतत् रामम् क्रूर कर्मा निशाचरः ॥३-२६-१२॥
verses.transliteration: tam mahā uraga saṁkāśam pragṛhya parigham raṇe ।dūṣaṇo abhyapatat rāmam krūra karmā niśācaraḥ ॥3-26-12॥

translations.english: With the spear that looked like a mighty serpent, Dusana, the cruel demon, advanced towards Rama.
translations.hindi: राक्षसां के फेंके हुए शब्धों को श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उसी प्रकार अपने वाणं से रोका, जिस प्रकार समुद्र नदियों की धारो को रोकता है

verses.sloka: तस्य अभिपतमानस्य दूषणस्य स राघवः ।द्वाभ्याम् शराभ्याम् चिच्छेद स हस्त आभरणौ भुजौ ॥३-२६-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tasya abhipatamānasya dūṣaṇasya sa rāghavaḥ ।dvābhyām śarābhyām ciccheda sa hasta ābharaṇau bhujau ॥3-26-13॥

translations.english: Seeing Dusana going to pounce upon him, Rama cut off with two arrows both his arms adorned with armlets.
translations.hindi: द्‌ क्र घोरे ७ ~ है च स तः पहरणधारभिन्नगात्रो न विव्यथे । राम हे ANC Cos पमः प्रदोष्तेन्नहु भिवज्ञरिव महाचज्ञः

verses.sloka: भ्रष्टः तस्य महाकायः पपात रण मूर्धनि ।परिघः छिन्न हस्तस्य शक्र ध्वज इव अग्रतः ॥३-२६-१४॥
verses.transliteration: bhraṣṭaḥ tasya mahākāyaḥ papāta raṇa mūrdhani ।parighaḥ chinna hastasya śakra dhvaja iva agrataḥ ॥3-26-14॥

translations.english: With the hands amputated, his huge spear, like the banner of Indra, slipped off his hands and fell down on the ground on the battle front.
translations.hindi: प्रतिजञ्जाइ--प्रविरुरोध | ( शो) नयोघान्‌--नदीधवाहान्‌ | (गोर ) ३ इतजदिग्धः रुघिरालिप्त: | ( गोऽ ) उस समय श्रीरासचन्द्र के समस्त अंगों के घायल हो जाने आर घावों से रुधिर बहने के कारण वे ऐसे जान पड़ते थे, जैसे सन्ध्या काल में मेघों से घिरा हुआ सूय हो

verses.sloka: कराभ्याम् च विकीर्णाभ्याम् पपात भुवि दूषणः ।विषाणाभ्याम् विशीर्णाभ्याम् मनस्वी इव महागजः ॥३-२६-१५॥
verses.transliteration: karābhyām ca vikīrṇābhyām papāta bhuvi dūṣaṇaḥ ।viṣāṇābhyām viśīrṇābhyām manasvī iva mahāgajaḥ ॥3-26-15॥

translations.english: Dusana fell down on the ground with broken hands like a proud elephant with both his tusks shattered.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा तम् पतितम् भूमौ दूषणम् निहतम् रणे ।साधु साधु इति काकुत्स्थम् सर्व भूतानि अपूजयन् ॥३-२६-१६॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tam patitam bhūmau dūṣaṇam nihatam raṇe ।sādhu sādhu iti kākutstham sarva bhūtāni apūjayan ॥3-26-16॥

translations.english: Seeing Dusaana collapse dead on the ground, all beings hailed Rama, saying, 'Well done, well done'.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के फेंके बास राक्षसों के शरीर को भेद और खन से तर हो, आकाश में जा, जाज्वल्यमान छासि की तरह शोभायमान हुए

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे क्रुद्धाः त्रयः सेना अग्र यायिनः ।संहत्य अभ्यद्रवन् रामम् मृत्यु पाश अवपाशिताः ॥३-२६-१७॥
verses.transliteration: etasmin antare kruddhāḥ trayaḥ senā agra yāyinaḥ ।saṁhatya abhyadravan rāmam mṛtyu pāśa avapāśitāḥ ॥3-26-17॥

translations.english: Meanwhile all the three army chiefs, Mahakapala, Sthulaksha, and the mighty Pramathi ran towards Rama in anger, bound (as though) by the noose of death.
translations.hindi: रणक्षेत्र में ये बाण कालदरड की तरह न तो किसी के रोके रुक ही सकते थे ओर न उनकी मार कोइ सह ही सकता था। श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने अनायांस ( अथात्‌ खेल ही खेल में ) सुवण भूषित और कक्क-पत्र से युक्त तथा अपनी सीध पर जाने वाले हज़ारों बाण छोड़े

verses.sloka: महाकपालः स्थूलाक्षः प्रमाथी च महाबलः ।महाकपालो विपुलम् शूलम् उद्यम्य राक्षसः ॥३-२६-१८॥
verses.transliteration: mahākapālaḥ sthūlākṣaḥ pramāthī ca mahābalaḥ ।mahākapālo vipulam śūlam udyamya rākṣasaḥ ॥3-26-18॥

translations.english: Mahakapala had a huge spear, Sthulaksha, a sharpedged spear and Pramathi, a battleaxe.

verses.sloka: स्थूलाक्षः पट्टिशम् गृह्य प्रमाथी च परश्वधम् ।दृष्ट्वा एव आपततः ताम् तु राघवः सायकैः शितैः ॥३-२६-१९॥
verses.transliteration: sthūlākṣaḥ paṭṭiśam gṛhya pramāthī ca paraśvadham ।dṛṣṭvā eva āpatataḥ tām tu rāghavaḥ sāyakaiḥ śitaiḥ ॥3-26-19॥

translations.english: On seeing them rushing to attack him with sharp weapons, Rama received them quickly with pointed arrows as though they were guests.

verses.sloka: तीक्ष्ण अग्रैः प्रतिजग्राह संप्राप्तान् अतिथीन् इव ।महाकपालस्य शिरः चिच्छेद रघुनंदनः ॥३-२६-२०॥
verses.transliteration: tīkṣṇa agraiḥ pratijagrāha saṁprāptān atithīn iva ।mahākapālasya śiraḥ ciccheda raghunaṁdanaḥ ॥3-26-20॥

translations.english: Mahakapala's head was cut to pieces with sharp arrows and Pramathi was killed with a countless series of arrows. Pramathi's body, like a huge tree with many branches collapsed on the ground.
translations.hindi: उस समय श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के धनुपमण्डल से अगणित बाण, जो अति उग्र थे ओर राक्षसा के लिए प्राणनाशक थे, छूट रहे थे

verses.sloka: असंख्येयैः तु बाण ओघैः प्रममाथ प्रमाथिनम् ।स्थूलाक्षस्य अक्षिणी स्थूले पूरयामास सायकैः ॥३-२६-२१॥
verses.transliteration: asaṁkhyeyaiḥ tu bāṇa oghaiḥ pramamātha pramāthinam ।sthūlākṣasya akṣiṇī sthūle pūrayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ ॥3-26-21॥

translations.english: Mahakapala's head was cut to pieces with sharp arrows and Pramathi was killed with a countless series of arrows. Pramathi's body, like a huge tree with many branches collapsed on the ground.

verses.sloka: स पपात हतो भूमौ विटपी इव महाद्रुमः ।दूषणस्य अनुगान् पंच सहस्रान् कुपितः क्षणात् ॥३-२६-२२॥
verses.transliteration: sa papāta hato bhūmau viṭapī iva mahādrumaḥ ।dūṣaṇasya anugān paṁca sahasrān kupitaḥ kṣaṇāt ॥3-26-22॥

translations.english: Rama filled the eyes of Sthulaksha with sharp arrows, and in anger shot five thousand arrows at the five thousand followers of Dusana in a moment and sent them to the abode of Yama.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जो के धनुष के रोदे से छूटे हुए बाणो ने राक्षसों के हाथ में पहनने र आभूषणे सहित बाहुओं और हाथी की तरह जंघाओं को छिन्न भिन्न कर डाला

verses.sloka: हत्वा तु पंच सहस्रान् अनयत् यम सदनम् ।दूषणम् निहतम् श्रुत्वा तस्य च एव पदानुगान् ॥३-२६-२३॥
verses.transliteration: hatvā tu paṁca sahasrān anayat yama sadanam ।dūṣaṇam nihatam śrutvā tasya ca eva padānugān ॥3-26-23॥

translations.english: Seeing Dusana and his followers killed, enraged Khara commanded his extremely strong army chiefs this way:

verses.sloka: व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धो सेन अध्यक्षान् महाबलान् ।अयम् विनिहतः संख्ये दूषणः स पदानुगाः ॥३-२६-२४॥
verses.transliteration: vyādideśa kharaḥ kruddho sena adhyakṣān mahābalān ।ayam vinihataḥ saṁkhye dūṣaṇaḥ sa padānugāḥ ॥3-26-24॥

translations.english: Dusana and his followers are killed in the battle. You, all the demons, along with your great army and different kinds of weapons should kill that wicked human being, Rama.
translations.hindi: नालीक, नाराच ( लोहे के बाण ) और पेली नोंक के विकर्शि (कान के आकार की नोक वाले) नाम के बा से जब राकस सारे | जाते, तब दे घायल हो, बड़ा भयङ्कर आतंनाद करते थे

verses.sloka: महत्या सेनया सार्धम् युद्ध्वा रामम् कुमानुषम् ।शस्त्रैः नाना विध अकारैः हनध्वम् सर्व राक्षसाः ॥३-२६-२५॥
verses.transliteration: mahatyā senayā sārdham yuddhvā rāmam kumānuṣam ।śastraiḥ nānā vidha akāraiḥ hanadhvam sarva rākṣasāḥ ॥3-26-25॥

translations.english: Dusana and his followers are killed in the battle. You, all the demons, along with your great army and different kinds of weapons should kill that wicked human being, Rama.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा खरः क्रुद्धो रामम् एव अभि दुद्रुवे ।श्येनगामी पृथुग्रीवो यज्ञशत्रुर् विहंगमः ॥३-२६-२६॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktvā kharaḥ kruddho rāmam eva abhi dudruve ।śyenagāmī pṛthugrīvo yajñaśatrur vihaṁgamaḥ ॥3-26-26॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के मर्मभेदी पने बाण से मदिठ, वह राक्षस | सेना किसी प्रक्रार अपनी रवा वे्सा नकर सकी जैसे सूखा जंगल आग लगने पर आग से अपनी रक्षा नहीं. कर सकता

verses.sloka: दुर्जयः करवीराक्षः परुषः कालकार्मुकः ।हेममाली महामाली सर्पस्यो रुधिराशनः ॥३-२६-२७॥
verses.transliteration: durjayaḥ karavīrākṣaḥ paruṣaḥ kālakārmukaḥ ।hemamālī mahāmālī sarpasyo rudhirāśanaḥ ॥3-26-27॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.

verses.sloka: द्वादश एते महावीर्या बल अध्यक्षाः ।स सैनिकाःरमम् एव अभ्यधावंत विसृजंतः शरोत्तमान् ॥३-२६-२८॥
verses.transliteration: dvādaśa ete mahāvīryā bala adhyakṣāḥ ।sa sainikāḥramam eva abhyadhāvaṁta visṛjaṁtaḥ śarottamān ॥3-26-28॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, angry Khara ran towards Rama. Syenagami, Pruthugriva, Yajnasatru, Vihanga, Durjaya, Karaveeraksha, Parusha, Kalakarmuka, Meghamali, Mahamali, Sarpasya, Rudhirasanaall these twelve valiant army chiefs along with their forces rushed towards Rama, releasing the sharpest arrows at him.

verses.sloka: ततः पावक संकाशैः हेम वज्र विभूषितैः ।जघन शेषम् तेजस्वी तस्य सैन्यस्य सायकैः ॥३-२६-२९॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pāvaka saṁkāśaiḥ hema vajra vibhūṣitaiḥ ।jaghana śeṣam tejasvī tasya sainyasya sāyakaiḥ ॥3-26-29॥

translations.english: Powerful Rama thereafter slayed the remaining army with his weapons studded with gold and diamonds and glowing like fire.

verses.sloka: ते रुक्म पुंखा विशिखाः स धूमा इव पावकाः ।निजघ्नुः तानि रक्षांसि वज्रा इव महाद्रुमान् ॥३-२६-३०॥
verses.transliteration: te rukma puṁkhā viśikhāḥ sa dhūmā iva pāvakāḥ ।nijaghnuḥ tāni rakṣāṁsi vajrā iva mahādrumān ॥3-26-30॥

translations.english: The goldtipped arrows which resembled fire covered with smoke shattered the army of demons like huge trees knocked down by thunder.
translations.hindi: जो राक्षस मारे जाने से बच गए थे वे बाणों की मार से पीड़ित हो र्षा के लिए खर की ओर दौड़े

verses.sloka: रक्षसाम् तु शतम् रामः शतेन एकेन कर्णिना ।सहस्रम् तु सहस्रेण जघान रण मूर्धनि ॥३-२६-३१॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣasām tu śatam rāmaḥ śatena ekena karṇinā ।sahasram tu sahasreṇa jaghāna raṇa mūrdhani ॥3-26-31॥

translations.english: Rama killed a hundred demons with one hundred arrows by a single stroke. The same way he killed a thousand of them with a thousand arrows on the battle front.

verses.sloka: तैः भिन्न वर्म आभरणाः छिन्न भिन्न शर आसनाः ।निपेतुः शोणित आदिग्धा धरण्याम् रजनीचराः ॥३-२६-३२॥
verses.transliteration: taiḥ bhinna varma ābharaṇāḥ chinna bhinna śara āsanāḥ ।nipetuḥ śoṇita ādigdhā dharaṇyām rajanīcarāḥ ॥3-26-32॥

translations.english: The demons fell down on the ground with their shields and ornaments broken, their bows stained with blood splintered.
translations.hindi: दूषण का सहारा पा कर वे सब भागे हुए राक्षस निर्भीक हो आर साल, ताल (वृक्ष विशेष) एवं शिला रूपी आयुधों को ले, फिर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के सामने गए

verses.sloka: तैः मुक्त केशैः समरे पतितैः शोणित उक्षितैः ।विस्तीर्णा वसुधा कृत्स्ना महावेदिः कुशैः इव ॥३-२६-३३॥
verses.transliteration: taiḥ mukta keśaiḥ samare patitaiḥ śoṇita ukṣitaiḥ ।vistīrṇā vasudhā kṛtsnā mahāvediḥ kuśaiḥ iva ॥3-26-33॥

translations.english: The entire ground was littered with bodies of demons fallen in the battle with loose hair and with drops of blood on them looking like a great sacrificial altar strewn all over with kusa grass.

verses.sloka: तत् क्षणे तु महा घोरम् वनम् निहत राक्षसम् ।बभूव निरय प्रख्यम् मांस शोणित कर्दमम् ॥३-२६-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tat kṣaṇe tu mahā ghoram vanam nihata rākṣasam ।babhūva niraya prakhyam māṁsa śoṇita kardamam ॥3-26-34॥

translations.english: With the slaughtered bodies of demons lying on the ground, the forest in a moment looked very dreadful like hell with the mud of soil soaked with flesh and blood.
translations.hindi: राच्चसों ने उक्षा और शिलाओं की श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ऊपर वर्षा की उस समय पूवे, भयङ्कर ओर रोमाञ्चकारी युद्ध हुआ

verses.sloka: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् ।हतानि एकेन रामेण मानुषेण पदातिना ॥३-२६-३५॥
verses.transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām ।hatāni ekena rāmeṇa mānuṣeṇa padātinā ॥3-26-35॥

translations.english: Fourteen thousand formidable demons were killed by Rama, a pedestrian human, singlehanded.

verses.sloka: तस्य सैन्यस्य सर्वस्य खरः शेषो महारथः ।राक्षसः त्रिशिराः चैव रामः च रिपुसूदनः ॥३-२६-३६॥
verses.transliteration: tasya sainyasya sarvasya kharaḥ śeṣo mahārathaḥ ।rākṣasaḥ triśirāḥ caiva rāmaḥ ca ripusūdanaḥ ॥3-26-36॥

translations.english: Of that entire army great warrior Khara,Trisira and Rama, destroyer of foes alone remained.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र ओर रात्तश्राँ ऋ किर बड़ा भीषण युद्ध हुआ । राक्षसों ने क्रोध में भर चारों ओर से श्रीरामचन्द्र जी पर १ संयुगे--सं ग्रामे । (-शि० ) वा८ रा० अ०--१३ तैश्च सवा दिशो दृष्टा प्रदिशश्च समाइताः । राक्षसेरुयतप्रासे! शरवपाभिवर्पिभिः

verses.sloka: शेषा हता महावीर्या राक्षसा रण मूर्धनि ।घोरा दुर्विषहाः सर्वे लक्ष्मणस्य अग्रजेन ॥३-२६-३७॥
verses.transliteration: śeṣā hatā mahāvīryā rākṣasā raṇa mūrdhani ।ghorā durviṣahāḥ sarve lakṣmaṇasya agrajena ॥3-26-37॥

translations.english: The rest of the mighty, dreadful, intolerable demons were killed on the war front by Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: ततः तु तद् भीम बलम् महा आहवेसमीक्ष्य रामेण हतम् बलीयसा ।रथेन रामम् महता खरः ततःसमाससाद इन्द्र इव उद्यत अशनिः ॥३-२६-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ tu tad bhīma balam mahā āhavesamīkṣya rāmeṇa hatam balīyasā ।rathena rāmam mahatā kharaḥ tataḥsamāsasāda indra iva udyata aśaniḥ ॥3-26-38॥

translations.english: Thereafter seeing the formidable army killed by mighty Rama, Khara lifted a thunderbolt like Indra, and advanced towards Rama in a great chariot. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वालमिकिय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षङ्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga in Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: उस ससय गन्धवोस्त्र से हज़ारों बाण निकले, जिनसे दसा दिशाएँ ढक गई
